summary_1line: Krishna urges Arjuna to kill Duryodhana, recalling past wrongs; Arjuna agrees and advances, while Duryodhana boldly challenges them before both armies.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna and Arjuna blow their conchs on a white-horsed chariot while the Kaurava army watches, convinced Duryodhana is already doomed.
Duryodhana stands firm on his chariot before the advancing Arjuna and Krishna, smiling defiantly as surrounding warriors shout in alarm.
Krishna, holding the reins, leans toward Arjuna and urges him to unleash his long‑cherished wrath upon Duryodhana in the midst of battle.
